name: 9-70 Entrenching Tool
effect: A 9-70 entrenching tool halves the time needed to dig trenches, foxholes, and other earthen fortifications. It also makes for a sturdy improvised weapon, as many a Guardsman can attest.

name: Auspex
effect: Activated as a Combat Action to detect energy emissions, motion, and other life signs within 50 metres.

name: Auto-Quill
effect: +2 bonus dice to Tests to forge or alter documents.

name: Ballistic Appeasement Auto-Reliquary (Absolutis Pattern)
effect: Clear a jammed weapon as a Free Action.

name: Clothing
effect: Clothing of a higher Rarity is a sign of status, and may grant small situational bonuses when making social Skill Tests (+1 bonus die to Persuasion or Influence, for example).
note: Rarity printed as "Variable", which is not a Rarity; stored as null. Entry starts on p.236, its Effect/Value/Rarity/Keywords are on p.237.

name: Combi-Tool
effect: You ignore DN penalties to build, repair, maintain, and sabotage Imperial technology.

name: Cameleoline Cloak
effect: +1 bonus die to Stealth (A) Tests and +1 to Defence when in shadow or cover.

name: Chaplet Ecclesiasticus
effect: The Chaplet can be used as a Symbol of Authority (p.240) or, if necessary, a garrote.

name: Chrono
effect: Settings on the chrono’s display allow for the accurate tracking of Imperial standard, shipboard, and local planetary time.

name: Data-Slate
effect: You can record any information transferable from a cogitator, such as local maps, familial records, or manufactorum outputs, onto your Data-Slate.

name: Diagnostor
effect: +1 bonus die to Medicae (Int) Tests to detect and diagnose diseases, injuries, and ailments, and to determine cause of death.

name: Grav-Chute
effect: You can hover or control a fall for up to one hour. You can recharge the Grav-Chute’s solar battery by leaving it in sunlight for one hour.

name: Jump Pack
effect: Using your Movement, you can fly at double your Speed by making a DN3 Pilot (A) Test, ignoring any terrain. If you fail the Pilot (A) Test, your movement deviates according to the Scattering (p.186) rules. A Complication triggers a crash, which deals a minimum of 1d3 Shock, plus falling damage (p.201).

name: Mag-Boots
effect: When activated with a Simple Action, the wearer’s feet are fully secured to any metallic surface. The wearer’s feet cannot be removed from the metallic surface by any means, other than their own volition. The wearer can walk and move on the metallic surface whilst the boots are on, but their Speed is reduced by 3.

name: Medikit
effect: You can make Medicae (Int) Tests to perform surgeries and heal others without suffering a DN penalty, including taking the Restore Shock option (p.124).

name: Chirurgeon’s Tools
effect: Functions as a Medikit. +2 bonus dice to Medicae (Int) Tests when a character is Dying.

name: Martyr’s Gift Medikit
effect: Functions as a Medikit. Includes a standard augmetic replacement for any lost limb or eye (p.242); the augmetic is temporary, and becomes useless after 24 hours. The subcutaneous frag charge has the same damage profile as a Frag Missile (p.220).

name: Missionary Kit
effect: Contains: sacred texts of the Imperial Creed, holy icon, incense, portable hymn-caster, liturgical pamphlets translated into several derivations of Low Gothic. +1 bonus die to Persuasion (Fel) Tests made involving converts to the Imperial Creed and those seeking redemption through the grace of the God-Emperor.
note: The contents list is printed above the Effect line; both are kept in effect.

name: Monoscope
effect: Can act as a light source and show live footage if connected wirelessly to a data-slate.

name: Munitorum-Issue Mess Kit
effect: +1 bonus die to Survival (Wil) tests made to find food and water.

name: Periculum Kit
effect: Contains: Chrono, Data-Slate, Magnocular Scope, 2 Ration Packs, Respirator, Vox-bead.
note: No Effect line printed; effect holds the printed contents list.

name: Preysense Goggles
effect: You ignore any penalties to Tests due to visual conditions.

name: Psychic Focus
effect: +1 bonus die to Psychic Mastery (Wil) Tests.

name: Ration Packs
note: No Effect line printed; the description says a pack feeds an adult Human for one day.

name: Respirator
effect: A Respirator canister lasts for 2 hours of continuous breathing. Whilst breathing through the Respirator, you are immune to breathable poisons and toxic atmospheres.

name: Rule of The Sororitas
effect: If you have the ADEPTA SORORITAS Keyword, you can read the Rule of Sororitas as part of a Regroup to recover 1d3 Shock.

name: Sacred Machine Oil
effect: You can choose to ignore a single Complication involving Imperial technology in any scene.

name: Slate Monitron
effect: +2 bonus dice to Medicae (Int) Tests made to heal your Wounds.

name: Stimm
effect: Can be used as part of a Medicae (Int) Test to restore 1d3 + 3 Shock.

name: Survival Kit
effect: Contains: compass, rope, water, purification filters, chemical testing strips. +1 bonus die to all Survival (Wil) Tests.
note: The contents list is printed above the Effect line; both are kept in effect.

name: Symbol of Authority
effect: +1 bonus die to Leadership (Wil) and Intimidation (Wil) Tests versus targets who would respect your position.

name: Uplifting Primer
effect: +1 bonus die to Scholar (Int) Test. A Complication on the Test means that the user learns potentially dangerous misinformation as determined by the GM.

name: Void Suit
effect: Protects the wearer from the vacuum of space, with enough oxygen for five hours of continuous use. Includes a Vox Caster.

name: Vox Bead
effect: You can communicate with anyone within 1,000 metres (one kilometre) that has a vox unit tuned to the same frequency.
note: Printed as a sub-entry under the "Vox" heading.

name: Vox Caster
effect: You can communicate with anyone within 100,000 metres (100 kilometres) that has a vox unit.
note: Printed as a sub-entry under the "Vox" heading.

name: Bonesinger Shard
effect: You ignore DN penalties to build, repair, maintain, and sabotage Aeldari technology.

name: Spirit Stone
effect: If an Aeldari dies while wearing a Spirit Stone, the Stone immediately absorbs the soul and stores it safely and secretly inside.

name: Webway Keystone
effect: You can make a DN 5 Tech (Int) Test to activate either of the following effects: Detect the distance and orientation of the nearest Webway portal. Open or close a Webway portal within 30 metres. Large or complex gates have higher DNs.

name: Ammo Runt
effect: The Ammo Runt has the profile of a Grot (p.358) and follows all the owner’s commands more or less loyally. You ignore all Complications related to your ranged weapons and gain +2 Ammo, which the Ammo Runt carries.

name: Dok’s Toolz
effect: Functions as a Medikit (p.238) for Ork biology. Whenever you roll a Complication whilst using a Dok Bag, the target suffers either 1 Wound or 1 Shock, whichever is funnier.
note: Printed heading is "Dok’s Toolz" but the text calls it a "Dok Bag"; copied as printed.
